content.thinking: I see the key/value split is incorrectly parsing "touches nothing" as a key due to the double space, when it should remain a single flag line with normal spacing. I need to fix that parsing issue.

content.text:
The fulcrum's `touches nothing` was written with two spaces, so it read as a key and a value. It is a flag and goes on one line with a single space.

```world
world  seesaw throw

floor
  friction  0.8, spinning 0.005, rolling 0.002

pivot
  is a  point
  at    1 m along, 40 cm up

fulcrum top
  is a  point
  at    1 m along, 38.5 cm up

fulcrum
  is a     post 6 cm square, from floor to fulcrum top
  touches nothing
  colour   grey

-- positive turn about y tips the far end down; the 0° stop holds the ball's end up
seesaw
  is a      box 120 by 20 by 3 cm, 500 g
  colour    wood
  friction  0.8, spinning 0.005, rolling 0.002
  at        1 m along, 40 cm up
  turns on  seesaw hinge, about y, at pivot
  swings    from 0° to 30°

ball
  is a      sphere 4 cm radius, 100 g
  colour    orange
  friction  0.8, spinning 0.01, rolling 0.004
  moves     freely
  rests     on seesaw, 55 cm behind seesaw

weight
  is a      sphere 6 cm radius, 1 kg
  colour    dark grey
  bounce    dead
  moves     freely
  at        50 cm ahead of seesaw, 2 m up

expect
  weight touches seesaw
  ball touches seesaw
```
